title: Add "Clear notification after 1 day" option to Settings / Activities
line: Notification settings have a new "Remove from history" option that clears old notifications automatically after an hour, a day or a week.
explanation: Notifications stayed in the history until the user pressed Clear History by hand; there was no way to have them go away on their own, which the reporter wanted for privacy. The change adds a HistoryTimeout setting (minutes, 0 = never) to plasmanotifyrc, a "Remove from history:" combo box in the Notifications KCM (Never, After 1 hour, After 1 day, After 1 week), and a Notifications::clearOlderThan() call that the notification applet runs every minute and whenever the setting changes. It removes the same items Clear History does (expired notifications and finished jobs), but only those last updated before the cut-off.

commits.message:
notifications: add option to remove old notifications from the history

Notifications stayed in the history until the user cleared it by hand,
which some people don't want for privacy reasons. Add a setting to
remove them automatically after an hour, a day or a week, or never.

BUG: 524431

media.caption: Notifications settings on master: no option to remove old notifications from the history
With the change: new "Remove from history:" combo box (Never / After 1 hour / After 1 day / After 1 week)
Master, HistoryTimeout=1 minute written to plasmanotifyrc: two notifications are still in the history after 2 minutes
With the change and the same 1-minute value: the history is emptied once the notifications are a minute old
